item.title: 'I'll always be friends with Modi': Trump calls India-US ties 'very special'; voices disappointment
item.description: Donald Trump affirmed his enduring friendship with Narendra Modi. He voiced concerns regarding Modi's recent actions. Trump acknowledged India-US relations as special, despite disagreements. He mentioned India's oil purchases from Russia and tariffs. The Ministry of External Affairs highlighted the importance of the India-US strategic partnership. Both nations share interests and democratic values.

item.title: Dubai travel alert: DXB warns of lane closures near terminals 1 and 3 from September 5 to 7, expect delays
item.description: Dubai International Airport (DXB) has issued a travel advisory for September 5–7 due to road works near Terminals 1 and 3, which are expected to cause lane closures and traffic delays. Passengers are urged to allow extra travel time or use the Dubai Metro. The advisory coincides with high travel demand during the UAE’s long weekend holiday.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Luigi Mangione featured in Shein ad: Brand launches investigation; shirt nearly sold out
item.description: Shein is probing its operations after an image of Luigi Mangione, accused of murdering UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, was used to model clothing on its website. The image, sourced from a third-party vendor, has been removed. The company is investigating and strengthening monitoring processes, with potential action against the vendor. An expert suggests the body might be AI-generated.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Duchess of Kent, Katharine dies at 92: Oldest living member of Royal Family; kin pays tribute to her lifelong service
item.description: The Duchess of Kent, Katharine, passed away peacefully at Kensington Palace on Thursday night at the age of 92. Married to Prince Edward, Duke of Kent, in 1961, she became the oldest living Royal Family member after Queen Elizabeth's death. Remembered for her compassion, especially at Wimbledon, and dedication to music and youth welfare, the Royal Family mourns her loss.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Donald Trump's high-IQ group: How many Indian-origin tech giants were present at Trump’s White House dinner – names and profiles
item.description: At a White House dinner hosted by President Trump, five Indian-origin tech executives, including Sundar Pichai and Satya Nadella, were recognized for their significant influence in the US tech sector. These leaders, representing companies like Google, Microsoft, and Micron Technology, highlighted their contributions to AI and innovation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Will be legitimate targets’: Vladimir Putin warns of direct attacks in Ukraine; blames Western forces for conflict
item.description: President Putin warned that any Western troops deployed to Ukraine would be considered legitimate targets, following pledges of postwar security guarantees including an international force. He argued such deployments wouldn't ensure lasting peace, citing growing military ties as a conflict root cause. Macron criticized Russia's troop movements despite ceasefire talks. Recent large-scale Russian attacks targeted Western Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: 10 days of must see global and indie cinema at Sharjah Film Platform 2025, grab early bird tickets now
item.description: The 8th Sharjah Film Platform runs from 14–23 November 2025, showcasing diverse international and regional films at Mirage City Cinema and other Sharjah venues. The Early Bird Pass, available for 40 AED for one month only, offers unlimited access to screenings plus festival merchandise, featuring acclaimed titles like On Becoming a Guinea Fowl and Yathoom by Emirati filmmaker Hana Kazim.

‘Illegitimate targeting’: US puts sanctions on Palestinian rights groups; condemns ICC probe into Israel
item.description: The U.S. sanctioned three Palestinian human rights organizations for allegedly instigating the International Criminal Court's (ICC) investigation into Israel, according to the Treasury Department. Secretary Rubio stated the groups targeted Israeli nationals without consent, prompting the action. The ICC's later arrest warrants for Israeli and Hamas leaders over war crimes allegations further fueled the controversy.

item.title: Who is Jim MacSween? Canada’s York police chief says ‘the best defence is to hide and comply during a home invasion’
item.description: York Regional Police Chief Jim MacSween's advice to "hide and comply" during home invasions has ignited controversy, drawing criticism from US conservatives like Kevin Sorbo. They contrast Canada's approach with the American emphasis on armed self-defense. The debate intensified following a fatal shooting during a home invasion, raising questions about public safety and individual rights.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Saudi Arabia delivers its first package by Drone: A big step toward faster, smarter logistics
item.description: Saudi Arabia conducted its first drone delivery trial in Jeddah, marking a major step toward modernizing logistics. Led by GACA and TGA, the initiative aligns with Vision 2030 goals of digital transformation and sustainability. The trial showcased reduced delivery times, regulatory readiness, and future scalability, positioning the Kingdom as a regional leader in smart logistics innovation
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Monkeying around? Nope — Orangutan seriously vibing to live music melts hearts online: Watch
item.description: A video from France is gaining attention. It shows a musician playing guitar for orangutans at La Boissière du Doré Zoo. One orangutan clapped during the performance. The video has received millions of views. People are praising the orangutans' emotional intelligence. The musician also sang for a white tiger at the zoo. Viewers said the tiger seemed to enjoy the music.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Joe Biden undergoes skin cancer surgery, fresh videos show head wound; frail appearance sparks concern - watch
item.description: Ex-US President, Joe Biden, was recently spotted with a visible mark on his head. Reports confirm that the 82-year-old underwent Mohs surgery for skin cancer treatment. Biden was seen leaving a church in Rehoboth Beach with a bandage. Earlier, he was seen wearing a cap to conceal the wound. In May, aides disclosed Biden's diagnosis of Stage 4 prostate cancer. Biden shared a message about strength in difficult times.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Vladimir Putin goes full Gen Z: Russian President learns what 'chill sesh' and 'total cringe' mean - video
item.description: At the Eastern Economic Forum, Vladimir Putin explored Gen Z slang while promoting regional development and Asia-Pacific cooperation. He visited the National Centre “Russia” and learned youth lingo translations. Beyond this lighthearted moment, Putin emphasized infrastructure projects and deeper energy cooperation, linking the Far East's growth to Russia's pivot toward Asia.
